_comment: Sessions used by every day3 script. To add a session collected later, add one entry: loader 'clean_tree' reads any folder built by clean-data/2026-11-24/scripts/build_clean.py (manifest.csv, floor*/stops|walks/<folder>/<phone>/<Sensor>.csv, wifi/observations.csv); 'names' maps its node names onto graph-v2 place names (see names_24nov.csv for the columns). Then rerun: sh phase2/new/day3/run_all.sh

phones._comment: Handset identity. Key = deviceModel read from each recording's meta/device.csv (phone_map.py). id = stable label used in files, results.json and keys; display = the name shown in the HTML pages, figures and tables, so rename display (e.g. "Michael's iPhone") and rerun, no code change. Per the user (2026-11-25): iPhone17,4 is an iPhone 16, iPhone19,2 an iPhone 18. A model id not listed here stops the pipeline instead of being guessed.

sessions.note: stops only logged magnetometer + barometer (ip16 = iPhone17,4), no accelerometer, so no tilt features
4 phones; iPhone slot = ip18 (iPhone19,2), not the same handset as 24s2
2 phones; iPhone slot = ip16 (iPhone17,4, the 23-Nov stop handset)

partial WhatsApp export: floor-5 round (track 'round': ip18 = iPhone19,2 + a56) and spot recordings (track 'spots': ip16 = iPhone17,4 + s24); labels per recording in clean-data/2026-11-25/clean/labels_used.csv

variants._comment: Optional variants of the stop data, chosen with DAY3_VARIANT=<name> (run_all.sh --split20). Output goes to out-<name>/; the default (no variant) is unchanged and writes out/. Rules and thresholds were fixed before any accuracy of the variant was computed (PROCESS-LOG entry 39).

split20._comment: User 2026-11-25: every stop take -> consecutive 20 s pieces (each its own sample, pieces of one take always on the same side of a split); 23-Nov stairs stops and sr8/sr10/sr11 excluded; obvious outlier pieces removed. Outlier thresholds chosen from the within-take spread of the pieces (|B| and field direction; the spread is in out-split20/variant_summary.json within_take_spread), not from accuracy.

split20_only._comment: Control for split20: the same 20 s pieces, but no exclusions and no outlier removal (only incomplete pieces dropped), to separate the effect of the split from the effect of removing data.
